- Hypotheses for part 2 (why 543 at 20 rps took > 45 s; unmeasured, for the post-close diagnostic): (1) one 429 whose X-RateLimit-Reset points at a window end far away (e.g. the hourly window) makes _pause_after_429 pause the WHOLE market bucket for MAX_429_PAUSE = 30 s: 27 s + 30 s = 57 s; later 429s extend it (max). (2) pacing at exactly 20.0/s on the client clock leaves no margin: network jitter bunches > 20 arrivals into one server second, so 429s are likely. (3) reset_delta uses the host clock against Questrade's timestamp: skew lengthens the pause. (4) waiters whose slot passed during a pause re-queue behind it. (5) httpx timeout is 30 s per attempt with up to 5 attempts, so a stalled connection can hold a request well past 45 s (only that request). The new market.opening_bars_* log line (elapsed_s, completed/outstanding, client_stats requests/http_429/pause_s/http_5xx/transport_errors) will tell which
